result.title: Coverage Hides Churn: Auditing and Preserving Conformal Decisions as VLM Label Registries Grow
result.comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: Vision-language classifiers can learn new labels from text alone, so the label lists they serve keep growing. We show that this growth silently changes conformal decisions about old labels. Common softmax-based conformal scores compare each label with an average over all labels; adding labels changes that average, and with it the score of every old label, even when the model, the image, and the old calibration data stay the same. Recalibrating after the update keeps the coverage guarantee, yet across eleven settings it changes at least one old decision on 53-90% of new images. Coverage cannot reveal this, because it checks only the true label: in five controlled settings that keep the old calibration, so that only the normalizer changes, old-class coverage moves by at most 0.01 while 60-67% of images change. We propose a lifecycle audit that measures these changes alongside coverage and set size, and a simple fix, PrefixCP: each class keeps the label registry that existed when it was added. Its old decisions then never change, each class keeps exact class-conditional coverage under exchangeability, and one prefix scan computes all historical normalizers at once. PrefixCP recovers 40.9-58.5% of the set-size gap between never updating the reference and recalibrating, which gives smaller sets but changes old decisions.

AI.brief_summary: 该文指出 VLM 标签注册表扩张会在模型与旧校准数据不变时改变基于 softmax 的 conformal 分数，从而使旧类别的判定悄然变化，并提出生命周期审计指标与 PrefixCP（为每类保留加入时的注册表前缀）来保持旧判定不变。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「覆盖率掩盖判定漂移」的审计思路可能可供核查：LVR 中聚合指标（准确率、整体覆盖率）是否同样掩盖了标签集或上下文扩展后逐样本推理/停止判定的变化，以及历史状态前缀是否能稳定旧决策。
